_about: DEMO DATA: a side-by-side (UTV) for local testing and screenshots (scripts/seed-demo.mjs --utv). The starter schedule is the kit's UTV schedule (src/vehicle.js, from the 2024 Polaris RZR XP 1000 owner's manual chart: miles, engine hours or months, whichever comes first); the CVT-belt and overheating diagnosis plans are built in for every UTV (src/generic-plans.js). schedule_research below is the research behind those schedules. Not anyone's real machine.

car.notes: Demo side-by-side: a made-up 2020 Polaris RZR XP 1000 with a little history (no VIN). Serviced by engine hours.

todos.title: Burning belt smell and slipping after a muddy ride
todos.notes: Revs up but doesn't pull on hills since crossing a deep creek. Smells like burnt rubber.

schedule_research.notes: Starter schedules, not model-exact. UTV list = 2024 Polaris RZR XP 1000 owner's manual maintenance schedule (sport side-by-side; whichever of hours/miles/months comes first; break-in items once at 25 h / 1 mo / 500 mi). ATV list = 2022 Polaris Sportsman 570 Touring/X2/6x6 owner's manual maintenance chart. Can-Am Maverick X3 numbers (aftermarket summaries, unverified against the BRP guide) run longer: oil and belt/pulley inspection about 100 h / 12 mo. Severe use (frequent mud, water or sand, constant high RPM, prolonged low-speed heavy loads, extended idling, short cold trips): Polaris says service at 50% of the stated interval; the 'severe' field gives that halved value. Mud/water crossings: check the front diff, rear diff/transmission/gearcase, the CVT housing (drain plug) and the air box for water after every deep crossing; milky or creamy fluid means water got in: change it now. (The Polaris immersion page covers air box, spark plugs, fuse box and PVT drying; the 'milky = change now' rule is general practice, verify for your machine.) Items marked 'verify' have no manual source here. Tire age and battery are date-only.

utv.notes: RZR XP 1000. Can-Am Maverick X3 is about 100 h / 12 mo per aftermarket guides (verify).
Also at break-in (25 h). Look for glazing, hourglassing, cords, missing cogs; measure width vs spec.
No fixed OEM interval: replace on inspection (wear, width under limit, damage). Many owners carry a spare. Typical life figures are forum lore: verify.

utv.item: CVT clutches clean/inspect (weights, rollers, bushings, buttons)
utv.notes: Also at break-in. Dealer item on many machines.

utv.item: Air filter inspect/clean, ducts and screens
utv.notes: Dust dependent: check far more often in dust. Replace as needed.
RZR schedule covers it under air filter ducts and screens; Sportsman chart says daily. Use pre-ride.

utv.item: Front diff / front gearcase fluid change

utv.notes: Level check at break-in. On RZR the transmission and rear gearcase are one unit; machines with a separate rear diff list it separately.
Check strength seasonally; pressure test yearly. Clean radiator with a garden hose, not a pressure washer.

utv.item: Grease fittings: A-arms, ball joints, prop shaft U-joints/carrier bearing; general lubrication
utv.severe: After every wash or mud ride (verify)
utv.notes: Polaris 'general lubrication'. At 50 h also check suspension bushings and ball joints, shocks for leaks. Prop shaft not listed separately in the RZR schedule.
No interval in the RZR schedule; Sportsman lists CV boots in the pre-ride inspection. A torn boot lets mud into the joint: replace the boot quickly.

utv.item: Winch inspect: cable/rope, hook, fairlead, mounting bolts, wiring
utv.notes: No interval in the RZR schedule; the Sportsman chart marks it severe-use with no interval. Check before each use (verify against the winch maker's manual).

utv.item: Battery: test, clean terminals, tend in storage
utv.notes: Date only. RZR: test/clean at every 25 h / 6 mo service. Keep on a tender when stored.
Date only: replace around 5-6 years from the DOT date code even if tread remains (general tire guidance, not from these manuals: verify).

atv.notes: On inspection only; no fixed interval.

atv.item: Front diff / front gearcase fluid change
Rear gearcase / final drive fluid change
atv.notes: Level check at break-in. Yamaha Grizzly: check final gear case for leaks before each ride.
Check level daily. The chart gives both 'every two years' and 60 months; use 24 mo if unsure.

atv.item: Grease fittings / general lubrication (A-arms, pivots, cables)
atv.notes: Suspension lube 50 h / 6 mo; steering 50 h / 6 mo (dealer).
Severe-use item with no interval. Check before each use (verify).

atv.item: Battery: terminals, clean, test, tend in storage
atv.notes: Date only in the app: monthly check.
Date only: about 5-6 years from the DOT date code (general guidance, verify).
